description.narrative: The Fund will target investments which deliver social and environmental benefits as well as financial returns, with a focus on decarbonization. The Fund intends to deploy capital to early-stage investments in both developers and early-stage corporates/platforms targeting proven, scalable, high-impact technologies and innovative business models to accelerate low carbon transition in the region - across utility/captive RE projects and distributed platforms like EE, E-mobility and grid infrastructure. Vietnam, Philippines and Indonesia will be the core focus countries.
